description: This Java class 'PayPalServices' provides methods for integrating with PayPal's NVP API, including setting up express checkout, updating checkout details, executing transactions (payment, authorization, capture, void, refund), and handling related data such as customer addresses, payment methods, and shipping estimates within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PayPalServices.TokenWrapper
classes.description: A serializable wrapper class for PayPal checkout tokens, with overridden equals and hashCode methods for use as map keys.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initializes a PayPal express checkout session, sets up cart details, and retrieves a checkout token from PayPal.

methods.name: payPalCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates shipping and address details during PayPal checkout, creates necessary address and contact records, and prepares the cart for payment.

methods.name: getErrorMessageMap
methods.description: Parses PayPal NVP response to extract error codes and messages if the response indicates failure.

methods.name: addCartDetails
methods.description: Adds cart items and totals to the NVP encoder for PayPal API requests.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Retrieves details of an ongoing PayPal express checkout, creates customer and address records if needed, and updates the cart.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the PayPal express checkout by executing the payment and updating the payment method with transaction details.

methods.name: doAuthorization
methods.description: Performs a PayPal authorization for a specified amount, returning success or error details.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction for a specified amount.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a PayPal authorization or transaction.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured PayPal transaction, either partial or full.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodGatewayPayPal
methods.description: Retrieves the PayPal payment gateway configuration based on context, such as product store or payment settings.

methods.name: sendNVPRequest
methods.description: Sends an NVP request to PayPal using configured API profile and returns the decoded response.

methods.name: getCountryGeoIdFromGeoCode
methods.description: Fetches the geographic ID for a country based on its geo code.

methods.name: parseStateProvinceGeoId
methods.description: Determines the geo ID for a state or province based on PayPal's returned code and country geo ID.
